settings_account_options_help: These details were selected when the company was created and cannot be changed here.
settings_scheduling_hours_rest: asks for hours/day across a start and end date.
settings_scheduling_days_rest: asks for a start, days of work, and days over — the end date follows from how thinly the work is spread.
settings_scheduling_blocks_rest: asks only for a start and days over — a pure booking with no hours, so utilisation is ignored.
settings_calendar_intro: Applies to the whole team — sets which day starts the week and the time zone used to determine "today".
settings_disciplines_intro: Group people by discipline across the app. Turn this off if your team doesn't use disciplines — they're then hidden from the schedule, resource form and navigation. Your existing discipline data is kept and reappears if you turn it back on.
settings_schedule_intro: How the week grid is drawn — applies to this browser. Minimise weekends shrinks the Saturday and Sunday columns so the working week dominates the view. Weekend work still shows; the columns just narrow. Snap to week start keeps the first day of the week pinned to the left edge so a stray scroll doesn't nudge the view onto a mid-week day. Compact view tightens the vertical spacing so more people fit on screen.
settings_internal_colours_intro: Choose whether internal activities and projects stay neutral grey or use their saved palette colours. Saved colours are kept when grey is selected.
settings_placeholders_intro: Placeholders are unfilled "slots" you can pencil in before a person is assigned — set per company. Off by default; when off they're hidden everywhere (the schedule, the assignee picker and the Resources list) but their data is kept.
settings_external_intro: Set per company. Off by default; when off externals are hidden everywhere (the schedule, the assignee picker and the Resources list) but their data is kept.
settings_internal_visibility_intro: Set per company; both on by default. Turn these off to hide internal work from the schedule — the bars simply disappear, but the work still counts towards everyone's capacity and utilisation, so a fully-booked person stays fully booked. The data is kept and returns when you turn them back on.
settings_activity_create_intro: Set per company; on by default. When off, the scheduler's allocation form no longer offers the inline box for adding a brand-new activity — you pick from the existing activity list instead.
settings_bar_labels_intro: What each bar on the schedule shows before the activity name — applies to this browser.
settings_utilisation_intro: Which utilisation figures appear on the scheduler.
settings_appearance_intro: Theme — applies to this browser. “Match system” follows your operating system.
settings_data_description: Download this company's data as a JSON file, or replace it from a file you exported earlier. Importing replaces everything in this company — most people never need it.

tour_grid_desc: Everyone's week at a glance — one row per person, one column per day. Click or drag on a row to schedule work.
tour_toolbar_desc: Search people, filter by client, project or activity, step through the weeks, and zoom between 1 and 8 weeks.
tour_people_desc: Add the people you schedule — freelancers included — and set their working days and time off.
tour_clients_desc: Clients own projects, and projects own the activities you schedule people onto. Start here when you're setting up.
tour_settings_desc: Week start, optional features, and your data — import, export and local backups — all live here.
notice_viewer_read_only: Read-only — you don't have edit access.
notice_company_access_removed: You no longer have access to that company.
notice_purge_grace_window: Can only be permanently deleted {days} days after deletion.
notice_sync_conflict: Someone else changed this company's data, so your last edit conflicted and was not saved. {app} is reloading the latest copy; after it reloads, review and re-apply your change.
notice_sync_receipt_uncertain: The server could not confirm every saved change, so the latest server copy was reloaded. Review your recent changes and re-apply anything missing.
notice_edit_dropped_reload: Your latest changes could not be saved before this company's data reloaded — please re-apply them.
notice_sync_too_large: This change is too large to save in one step. Try changing or deleting fewer items at a time; your other changes are unaffected.
notice_sync_keepalive_not_dispatched: This change was too large to save while this page was closing. Keep this page open until the save warning clears, then try again.
external_explainer: External / 3rd parties are outside companies you hand work to but don’t manage — e.g. a print shop or overflow studio. They appear on the schedule so you can see the handoff, but carry no hours and never count toward your team’s capacity or utilisation. They are not your own people (Resources) and not unfilled slots (Placeholders).
domain_error_record_wrong_account: That record does not belong to the active company.
domain_error_reference_wrong_account: That change references data outside the active company.
domain_error_activity_project_required: A project-specific activity must be assigned to a project.
domain_error_activity_project_forbidden: An internal or cross-project activity cannot belong to a project.
domain_error_activity_phase_forbidden: An internal or cross-project activity cannot belong to a phase.
domain_error_activity_phase_wrong_accoun: Activity phase must belong to this company.
domain_error_activity_phase_project_requ: An activity with a phase must also belong to that phase’s project.
domain_error_activity_phase_project_mism: Activity phase must belong to the activity’s project.
domain_error_resource_project_forbidden: Only a placeholder can be assigned to a project.
domain_error_allocation_references_inval: Allocation must reference an existing resource and activity in this company.
domain_error_allocation_resource_inactiv: Allocation must reference an active resource in this company.
domain_error_allocation_project_inactive: Allocation must reference an activity under an active project in this company.
domain_error_allocation_activity_inactiv: Allocation must reference an activity under an active project.
domain_error_placeholder_project_missing: This placeholder is not bound to a project yet.
domain_error_placeholder_project_mismatc: A placeholder can only be assigned to activities from its bound project.
domain_error_external_allocation_hours: An external / 3rd-party resource’s allocation can’t carry hours.
domain_error_resource_external_dependent: Reassign or remove this resource’s work and time off before making it external.
domain_error_placeholder_project_depende: Reassign or remove this placeholder’s work before changing its bound project.
domain_error_activity_project_dependents: Reassign placeholder work before changing this activity’s project.
domain_error_date_required: Start and end dates are required.
domain_error_date_invalid: Dates must be valid calendar dates (YYYY-MM-DD).
domain_error_date_reversed: End date cannot be before the start date.
domain_error_date_span_too_long: Date span cannot exceed {max} calendar days.
domain_error_time_off_resource_invalid: Time off must reference an existing resource in this company.
domain_error_time_off_resource_inactive: Time off must reference an active resource in this company.
domain_error_time_off_external_resource: Time off can’t be recorded for an external / 3rd-party resource.
domain_error_project_client_required: A project must belong to a client.
validation_hex_invalid: Choose a colour from the available swatches.
validation_working_days_required: Select at least one working day.
reauth_body: For your security, changes like managing members or deleting data need a recent sign-in. Confirm your password to continue — you won't lose your place.
reauth_body_sso: For your security, changes like managing members or deleting data need a recent sign-in. Re-authenticate with your identity provider to continue — you won't lose your place.
reauth_failed: Could not confirm your identity. Check your password and try again.
reauth_still_not_fresh: Re-authentication did not refresh your session. Sign out and back in, then try again.
reauth_2fa_body: Enter the six-digit code from your authenticator app to finish confirming.
reauth_2fa_recovery_body: Enter one unused recovery code to finish confirming.
